title: Palacio San José, Entre Ríos

buildingCutout.basis: Suppresses only the building mass matching the mapped main residence so the two mapped courts remain open.

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain at the central approach immediately in front of the palace.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap relation 3901483 fixes the main palace and its two open courtyards. Named museum node 198408160 supplies the site identity. Argentina’s national monuments record establishes the twin-tower front, Tuscan arcade and axial sequence of courtyards.
mapIdentity.scope: Mapped main residence enclosure and the two court voids, with the axial visitor gallery and gates, two square towers, pale Tuscan arches and pink stucco fixed by four exact same-day photographs.

note: The main approach is the terrain-contact datum. Estimated terrace, gallery and courtyard surfaces bridge the original relief with shallow thresholds, while the two flanking towers rise above the one-story gallery.
